text: dsh-imagegen 是面向 DSH 的图像生成插件，提供 image_gen 工具和 /imagine 命令。它通过 OpenAI 兼容的 images/generations 接口调用 xAI 等图像服务，可选择模型、尺寸和质量，也能使用本地图片、数据 URL 或网络图片作为参考。生成结果保存到工作区和 DSH 归档目录，并可在支持图像输入的路由中以内嵌图像呈现。适合希望在 DSH 对话中生成或编辑图像的用户。默认需要 XAI_API_KEY，也可配置兼容服务。

dsh-imagegen adds image_gen and /imagine to DSH. It sends prompts to an OpenAI-compatible image API, using xAI by default. Choose a model, size, quality, and optional reference image; results are saved in the workspace and DSH archive. Requires XAI_API_KEY by default.
想在 DSH 对话里根据文字提示生成一张图片。
有没有办法在 DSH 里直接运行 /imagine 画图？
我想把生成的图片保存到当前工作区并留一份归档。
让 DSH 能用图像模型生成不同尺寸和质量的图片。
能不能拿一张本地图片当参考再生成新图？
我想在 DSH 里用兼容 OpenAI 图片接口的服务画图。
Generate an image from a prompt inside a DSH session.
Can I use a reference image when creating a new picture?
dsh-imagegen 的功能「提示词生成图像」：调用 image_gen 并提交提示词，可指定模型、尺寸、质量和文件名。图片写入工作区及 DSH 归档目录，支持图像的路由还可收到内嵌附件。
dsh-imagegen 的功能「/imagine 快速生成」：在 DSH 输入 /imagine 和描述即可立即请求生成，无需额外模型回合；命令返回生成模型和文件路径。
dsh-imagegen 的功能「参考图生成」：image_gen 可接收本地路径、data URL 或 HTTPS 图片作为参考；本地图片会读取并编码后随图像请求提交。
dsh-imagegen 的功能「双位置保存」：生成的图片按实际图片格式确定扩展名，保存到工作区配置目录，并另存于 DSH_HOME/generated_images/ 以便归档。
dsh-imagegen 使用时会把提示词和可选参考图发送到配置的图像服务；默认服务为 api.x.ai，需要有效 API 凭据。
dsh-imagegen 会在本机创建工作区输出目录和 DSH 图像归档目录，并将生成图片写入两处。
dsh-imagegen 提供工具 image_gen：Generate a raster image from a text prompt; accepts file name, model, size, quality, and reference image.
dsh-imagegen 提供命令 /imagine：Generate an image now from a prompt.

dsh-imagegen README · dsh-imagegen：Codex-style `image_gen` and grok-build `/imagine` for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

DeepSeek chat-completions is text-only, and DSH does not ship a native text-to-image API. This bundle registers:

| Surface | Mirrors | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Model tool `image_gen` | Codex built-in `image_gen` | The agent draws on request; files land in the workspace |
| Slash command `/imagine <prompt>` | grok-build `/imagine` | Generates immediately, no model turn |

dsh-imagegen README · dsh-imagegen：The backend is OpenAI-compatible `POST {baseURL}/images/generations`. Shipped defaults target [xAI](https://docs.x.ai/docs/guides/image-generation):

- `https://api.x.ai/v1`
- credential name `XAI_API_KEY`
- model `grok-imagine-image-quality`

Any compatible gateway works (OpenAI, OpenRouter, a local proxy). Override `baseURL`, `apiKeyEnv`, and `model` in the profile patch. Never put the API key in the patch file.

dsh-imagegen README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/songlairui/dsh-imagegen/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz
```

Restart the running `dsh web` process. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should include a `# == dsh-imagegen` layer.

Store the key in DSH credentials (Settings → Models) under `XAI_API_KEY`, or export `XAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

dsh-imagegen README · Use：> Use image_gen to draw a shiba in sunglasses as a 35mm film still, save as shiba.png

or:

```
/imagine a shiba in sunglasses, film still, 35mm
```

Outputs:

- workspace `generated_images/<name>.png`
- `$DSH_HOME/generated_images/<name>.png`

If the current route declares image input (for example a `grok-4` vision model), the tool result also carries a durable DSH image block so the picture can render inline.

dsh-imagegen README · Configuration：A profile patch replaces the whole `config` object. Restate every field you care about in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: imagegen
  name: dsh-imagegen
  config:
    baseURL: https://api.x.ai/v1

OpenAI Images:

```yaml
    baseURL: https://api.openai.com/v1
    apiKeyEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY
    model: gpt-image-2
```

Any other OpenAI-compatible `images/generations` endpoint: set `baseURL` to that origin plus `/v1`, and `apiKeyEnv` to the credential name you stored in DSH.

dsh-imagegen README · Tool parameters：`image_gen(prompt, file_name?, model?, size?, quality?, reference_image?)`

- `prompt` required
- `file_name` e.g. `hero.png`
- `model` overrides the default
- `size` `1024x1024` / `1536x1024` / `2K` / `auto`
- `quality` gpt-image only: `low` / `medium` / `high` / `auto`
- `reference_image` local path, data URL, or https URL

dsh-imagegen README · Key resolution：1. `ctx.credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)`
2. Environment variables `XAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`
3. A non-expired xAI key in `~/.grok/auth.json` (grok CLI cache), if present
